LanguageData.HD_TacticalCloseQuartersStrike_CommandDe: Use a long gun to push a nearby pawn away and briefly stun them. Colliding with a wall along the knockback path doubles the stun duration.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalCloseQuartersStrike_InvalidTa: The target is not a valid close-quarters strike target.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalCloseQuartersStrike_TooFar: Move adjacent to the target before using close-quarters strike.
